title: Cash-out for kitchen remodel, payment worries, rep overpromises
scenario: Chatty homeowner wants about sixty thousand cash out for a kitchen remodel but worries the new payment will be too high. The rep quotes a payment and promises approval.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Good afternoon, is this Bev? Hi Bev, it's Tomas with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, hi Tomas! Yes, I was hoping someone would call. My kitchen is from nineteen eighty-eight, I'm not even kidding.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, oh no. So you're thinking cash-out refinance to fund a remodel?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: That's the idea. My neighbor did one and her kitchen is gorgeous now. Absolutely gorgeous.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Love it. How much are you thinking you'd need?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: The contractor said around sixty thousand. Maybe sixty-five if I go with the nicer countertops.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And what do you think the home's worth these days?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Zillow says four-forty, but who knows with Zillow.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Right, we'd confirm with an appraisal. And the current balance?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: About two-twenty. But here's my worry, my payment is fine right now. I don't want it to jump to something crazy. Rates are so high now compared to when I bought.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a really common concern. Honestly, for a cash-out like that you'd probably be looking at about nineteen-fifty a month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Nineteen-fifty? I pay fourteen hundred now. That's a big jump.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It's a jump, but you're getting sixty-five thousand for the kitchen.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I suppose. Do you think I'd even qualify? I retired from teaching last year, it's mostly pension now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh, with that much equity you'll definitely qualify, don't worry about that.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Well, that's a relief. What would you need from me?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Your pension award letter, a couple of bank statements, and your mortgage statement to start.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I have all of that in a folder somewhere. I'm very organized, my late husband used to tease me about it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That'll make this easy. Can I set up a time to go through everything properly?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure. But still, that payment makes me nervous. It's just a lot higher.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understandable. We can look at options when we sit down. How's Monday at eleven?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Monday at eleven is fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Wonderful. Talk Monday, Bev.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Bye now, Tomas!
